title: MAHATRANSCO Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 24 Apprentice Posts
description: Maharashtra State Electricity Transmission Company (MAHATRANSCO) has issued the official notification for 2026. To fill 24 vacancies for Apprentice Jobs. Those candidates who have qualified in 10th Pass or ITI can grab this chance and apply for the MAHATRANSCO Notification 2026. Here, we include the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
